Follow one vial from the skyline to your door.

PEPTICITY is clinician-guided peptide care. A licensed clinician decides if a plan is right for you, a licensed partner pharmacy prepares it, and every vial carries a lot code you can look up. Scroll, and follow one vial down.

01 / 06 · Assess

You take the free assessment.

Your goals, your age range and the medicines you take. No payment, no commitment. One window in the skyline lights up.

02 / 06 · Review

A licensed clinician reads it.

A real clinician reviews your answers, may ask for labs, and decides if a plan is right for you.

03 / 06 · Decide

A clear yes or no.

You get the reasons either way. If peptides aren’t right for you, you pay nothing. [Confirm policy with Grace]

04 / 06 · Prepare

A licensed pharmacy prepares it.

Filled to your prescription by a licensed partner pharmacy, never a research-chemical supplier.

05 / 06 · Test

Every lot is tested.

Each lot gets a certificate of analysis. The lot code on your vial opens it.

06 / 06 · Deliver

It arrives cold, at your door.

Sealed, insulated and shipped cold, with a person to call at [phone number].

The list

Lot testing

Don’t trust us. Check us.

Every lot is tested before it is released. The code printed on your vial opens that lot’s certificate.

  1. Find the lot code printed on the back of your vial.
  2. Enter it in the lot lookup on our site.
  3. Read the certificate: identity, purity, sterility and endotoxin. [Sample data in this preview]
